occupancy.active_warps_per_sm: int: number of active warps per SM
occupancy.active_blocks_per_sm: int: number of active thread blocks per SM

<access_name>.sectors_per_request: int: number of 32-byte sectors touched by one warp request

<access_name>.bank_conflict_degree: int: maximum number of threads accessing the same bank

notes.sections: Include 'occupancy' for all regular kernels. Include 'global_memory' only if the kernel has global_memory_accesses. Include 'shared_memory' only if the kernel has shared_memory_accesses.
notes.optimal_launch: The 'optimal_launch' kernel uses a different format: {'optimal_block_size': int, 'maximum_occupancy_pct': float}. No occupancy/global_memory/shared_memory sections.
notes.limiting_factor_ties: When multiple factors produce the same minimum block count, report the alphabetically first among the tied factors.
